title: Box breathing — 5 minutes
hypothesis: Five minutes of gentle box breathing once daily will reduce subjective stress scores over 14 days without dizziness or distress.

intervention.summary: Sit comfortably and breathe in a gentle 4-4-4-4 pattern for about five minutes.
steps: Sit upright, soft gaze or eyes closed.
Inhale gently ~4 counts, hold ~4, exhale ~4, hold ~4.
Keep effort easy — never strain or gasp.
Stop immediately if dizzy, chest pain, or panic increases.

timing.phase_note: Not for emergency panic or medical distress — use emergency services when needed.

expected_effect.note: Some people feel no change; that is valid data.

contraindications: Unstable heart or lung disease without clinician clearance
Pregnancy complications where breath-hold practices were restricted
Active panic attack requiring medical care

safety.emergency_route: Chest pain, trouble breathing, or suicidal crisis: emergency services / local crisis line.
